description: This file defines the `RemotePortTunnel` class that manages SSH-based port forwarding tunnels for remote connections. It includes functionality for creating, managing, and cleaning up SSH tunnels, handling port availability, and parsing configuration settings.

classes.name: RemotePortTunnel
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the SSH port forwarding tunnel, managing its lifecycle, process, and associated network resources.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Asynchronously creates and establishes a new SSH tunnel for remote port forwarding.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates the SSH tunnel and cleans up resources.
